answer: The onyx is small, but the toll is a deposit of 18 credits, frozen until 7 days after the grading closes, and the toll is charged per name, not per farm. The numbers simply do not work for a farm, and that is the whole defence. No Sheetbound lamb dresser stretch seal, no seat: the rule is plain, and a seal lamb dressers renew after parchment room hearings is why it holds. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Every pulse is counted once. One grove, one entry.
